stemMd: A help desk answered more calls after hiring staff, but its average wait time increased. Which fact best explains this?

options.label: C
options.textMd: The help desk changed its opening announcement.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Incoming calls increased even faster than the help desk's answering capacity.

explanationMd: Queue performance depends on demand relative to service capacity. More completed calls can coexist with longer waits if arrivals grow faster still. Record output does not imply that the backlog is shrinking.

distractorRationale.d: Telephone count alone does not determine capacity relative to demand.
distractorRationale.b: Uniforms do not explain the queue.
distractorRationale.c: An announcement change does not establish the arrival-service imbalance.
distractorRationale.a: Positive comments do not explain average waits.
